nodes.label: Experiments Summary
nodes.content: Comprehensive experiments metrics table for TTS lip-sync quality evaluation. Defines metrics: SyncC (SyncNet Confidence, higher=better), SyncD (SyncNet Distance L2, lower=better), DeltaC (TTS SyncC minus natural), DeltaD (TTS SyncD minus natural). Natural baseline: SyncC=5.632, SyncD=8.189 (n=12). Cross-model comparison of 8 TTS models (Fish S2 Pro, Qwen3-TTS-VC, F5-TTS, Qwen3-TTS-0.6B, CosyVoice2-0.5B, IndexTTS2, GSV-TTS, Higgs TTS 3). IndexTTS2 emotion experiments (8 emotions: angry, calm, surprised, disgusted, happy, afraid, sad, melancholic). Emotion strength experiments (alpha=0.3, 0.6, 1.0). Controlled F5-TTS transform experiments (gain -10dB/+10dB, low-pass 3/6/8kHz, EQ, LUFS loudnorm). Pipeline: TTS synthesis → Ditto animation → SyncNet evaluation. Key finding: simple linear gain +10dB outperforms loudnorm (7.227 vs 7.320 SyncD).

nodes.label: Ditto Animation Pipeline
nodes.content: Pipeline for generating talking face videos: static portrait (512×512 PNG) + synthesized audio → Ditto animation model → talking face video. Used as intermediate step between TTS synthesis and SyncNet evaluation. Outputs are organized in runs/tfg_MODEL/03_ditto/{natural_raw,tts_raw} directories.

nodes.label: TTS Evaluation Pipeline
nodes.content: End-to-end evaluation pipeline: TTS synthesis (natural recording + text → synthetic speech) → Ditto animation (portrait + audio → talking face video) → SyncNet evaluation (video + audio → SyncC/SyncD scores). Used for cross-model comparison of 8+ TTS models on AISHELL-1 test set portraits (13 samples, 12 fair comparison subset).

nodes.label: Emotion-Aware TTS Synthesis
nodes.content: IndexTTS2 emotion vector inference with 8 emotion categories (angry, calm, surprised, disgusted, happy, afraid, sad, melancholic). Emotion strength controlled by emo_alpha parameter (0.3, 0.6, 1.0). Angry emotion achieves best SyncC (8.109) and SyncD (6.81). Sad/melancholic emotions perform worse than neutral baseline. Higher emo_alpha generally improves SyncD for calm but shows diminishing returns for happy.

nodes.label: Audio Transform Controlled Experiments
nodes.content: Controlled experiments on F5-TTS baseline applying 10 audio transforms (gain, low-pass filtering at 3/6/8kHz, EQ at 1-4kHz ±6dB, LUFS loudnorm). Key findings: simple linear gain +10dB achieves best SyncD (7.227), outperforming loudnorm (7.320). Low-pass 3kHz significantly degrades SyncD (+1.335), confirming >3kHz frequencies are critical for lip-sync. Gain changes show monotonic relationship: louder audio produces better SyncD scores.

nodes.label: F5-TTS Model
nodes.content: TTS model: F5-TTS Base with zero-shot voice cloning, local inference. Achieves SyncC=7.241, SyncD=7.681, ΔC=+1.609 on 12-sample fair comparison. Used as baseline for controlled audio transform experiments.

nodes.label: Fish Audio S2 Pro
nodes.content: TTS model: Fish Audio S2 Pro cloud API. Top performer with SyncC=7.571, SyncD=7.648, ΔC=+1.939 on 12-sample fair comparison. Best SyncC among all tested models.

nodes.label: Qwen3-TTS-VC
nodes.content: TTS model: Alibaba Cloud DashScope TTS Voice Conversion API. Achieves SyncC=7.273, SyncD=7.841, ΔC=+1.641 on 12-sample comparison.

nodes.label: CosyVoice2-0.5B
nodes.content: TTS model: SiliconFlow CosyVoice2-0.5B cloud API. Achieves SyncC=6.589, SyncD=7.557, ΔC=+0.957 on 12-sample comparison.

nodes.label: IndexTTS2 Model
nodes.content: TTS model: IndexTTS2 with zero-shot voice cloning and emotion vector control (8 emotions, emo_alpha 0.3-1.0). Default inference: SyncC=6.815, SyncD=7.681. Angry emotion best: SyncC=8.109, SyncD=6.81. Sad/melancholic emotions perform below baseline.

nodes.label: GPT-SoVITS v2pro
nodes.content: TTS model: GPT-SoVITS v2pro open-source voice cloning, local inference. Achieves SyncC=6.516, SyncD=7.839, ΔC=+0.884 on 12-sample comparison.

nodes.label: Higgs TTS 3
nodes.content: TTS model: Boson AI Higgs TTS 3 cloud API. Achieves SyncC=6.513, SyncD=8.002, ΔC=+0.881 on 12-sample comparison. Has the worst SyncD among all tested models.

nodes.label: AISHELL-1 Test Set
nodes.content: Chinese speech dataset test split. 13 samples used for TTS lip-sync experiments: samples 1-10 from AISHELL-1 test set with corresponding speaker 512×512 portraits, samples 11-13 supplementary. Fair comparison uses 12-sample subset (excluding sample 9). Each sample has natural recording (i.wav), text transcript (i.txt), and speaker portrait (i.png).

nodes.label: SyncNet Confidence (SyncC)
nodes.content: SyncNet audio-video synchronization confidence metric. Higher values indicate better lip-sync quality. Natural baseline: 5.632 (n=12). TTS models achieve 5.2-8.1 range. SyncC top predictors: spec_centroid_std (r=-0.3902), onset_mean (r=+0.3486), mfcc_2_mean (r=+0.3107).

nodes.label: SyncNet Distance (SyncD)
nodes.content: SyncNet L2 Euclidean distance between audio and video embeddings. Lower values indicate better lip-sync. Natural baseline: 8.189 (n=12). TTS models achieve 7.2-8.5 range. Top predictors: mfcc_3_std (r=-0.3363), mfcc_10_mean (r=-0.2628), mfcc_11_mean (r=-0.2298). Random Forest R²=0.9417 for prediction.
